en.html:
A silver warrior—the Silver Star—had appeared. The army surrounding Muramasa, whether Rokuhara or the occupation force, had gone mad. This must be what they called mental contamination.

Now some of them were moving toward Katase in a disorderly column.
They had to be stopped. Otherwise, catastrophe.

But Muramasa—Kageaki—could not leave that place.
Somebody else had to go.

Haan. Her. Who else?

銀色の武者――銀星号だ――が現れ、村正を取り囲
んでいた軍隊――六波羅だか進駐軍だか――は狂った。
　あれが精神汚染というやつに違いない。

　その一部が無秩序な隊伍を組んで、片瀬方面へ向か
っている。
　止めなくてはならない。大惨事になる。

　だが村正――景明はあの場を離れられない。
　他の誰かが行くしかない。

　つまり、自分だ！

en.html: For Ichijou, deciding and doing occupied the same starting point. Hesitation, dithering, all that loss of energy in between: zero. Thinking was for working out how. How, then? The shortest route to Katase was no good. Most likely it would take her into the contamination zone. She would have to keep to the island's outer edge as much as possible. Would she arrive in time? Any other way?◆ None. Bas, that discussion finished. Then what? How to stop an armed military unit? Any choice except facing them just as she was?◆ None. That discussion also finished. Thinking done. Now do what could be done.
en.text:
For Ichijou, deciding and doing occupied the same starting point. Hesitation, dithering, all that loss of energy in between: zero.

Thinking was for working out how.

How, then?

The shortest route to Katase was no good. Most likely it would take her into the contamination zone.

She would have to keep to the island's outer edge as much as possible.
Would she arrive in time?

Any other way?◆
None. Bas, that discussion finished.

Then what? How to stop an armed military unit?

Any choice except facing them just as she was?◆
None. That discussion also finished.

Thinking done.
Now do what could be done.

ja.html: 一条にとって、決断と行動の起点は同座標にある。 　躊躇い、逡巡などというエントロピーは皆無だ。 　考えることがあるとすればそれは目的を達する為の 思索に限られる。 　 　――どうすれば良いか。 　片瀬まで最短距離を抜けては行けない。 　それではおそらく〝汚染〟の範囲に巻き込まれる。 　可能な限り島の外縁を経由して向かう必要がある。 　それで間に合うか。 　他に手段は？◆ 　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。 　辿り着いた後はどうするか。 　武装した軍隊をどう止める？ 　このまま・・・・立ち向かう以外の方法は？◆ 　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。 　思考終了。 　後は可能行動を実施するだけだった。
ja.text:
一条にとって、決断と行動の起点は同座標にある。
　躊躇い、逡巡などというエントロピーは皆無だ。


　考えることがあるとすればそれは目的を達する為の
思索に限られる。
　
　――どうすれば良いか。

　片瀬まで最短距離を抜けては行けない。
　それではおそらく〝汚染〟の範囲に巻き込まれる。

　可能な限り島の外縁を経由して向かう必要がある。
　それで間に合うか。

　他に手段は？◆
　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。

　辿り着いた後はどうするか。
　武装した軍隊をどう止める？

　このまま・・・・立ち向かう以外の方法は？◆
　――無し。この点の考察を打ち切る。

　思考終了。
　後は可能行動を実施するだけだった。

She knew the man she had run into.
Friend, however, would be a very serious misdescription.

Ichizo Sorimachi.
Small-time gangster, eating from two plates: the shogunate's hired Nogiyama Group and the occupation force.

What was he doing here?

In Ichijou's head, the facts joined up. His injuries. His drowned-rat appearance. His background. What had happened just before.

Ichijou"Bhosdike. This can wait. Move, I have work."
Sorimachi"Oho? Is that so...?"
Ichijou"Your army friends have gone mad. They're heading into town, and I'm going to stop them. Hat. Move."

Ichijou"Kill you and go. Ichizo Sorimachi."
Sorimachi"One small question... Has madam ever killed anybody?"
Ichijou"No."
Sorimachi"Heh, heh...! And still you can kill me?"
Ichijou"Your neck breaks, you die. Special exemption for you, is there?"
Sorimachi"................"
Sorimachi"Heh, heh, heh! HYA-HIHIHIHIHIHIHI!!"
Sorimachi"Yes—THAT! Exactly how it should be!"
Sorimachi"You are exactly the person I took you for... Miss Ayane."
Ichijou"—"

en.html:
Sorimachi"Ohh... frightening. Very frightening..."
Ichijou"..."
Sorimachi"No obstruction from my side. Only, madam, aage ka socha? What happens when you get there?"
Sorimachi"An army on the other side. One fist is not much of an answer, is it?"
Ichijou"Won't know till I try."
Sorimachi"Without trying also, is the answer not visible?"
Ichijou"One thing I know. Stand here saying that, keep doing nothing, and nobody gets saved. Guaranteed."
Sorimachi"................ Heh-heh."
Ichijou"If I try, maybe I can save somebody. That's why I'm going."
Sorimachi"Madam."
Ichijou"Bye."
Sorimachi"Power is required, perhaps?"
Ichijou"..."
Sorimachi"Enough power to scatter even an army. Just now, that would be useful, no?"
Ichijou"What are you getting at, you gutter rat?"
Sorimachi"This lighthouse was my camp also. As it happens, something is still here..."
Sorimachi"A tool for the operation entrusted to me."
Ichijou"...?"
Sorimachi"Mind you, first I hauled it all the way here. After all that effort I discovered it cannot be used for that work. It chooses its master, you see..."
Sorimachi"But you, madam... you might..."

en.html:
Katase Beach—or former beach, perhaps—was in chaos.
Enoshima had come flying in. After that, who was going to turn over in a warm quilt and continue sleeping?

For a whole island crashing into the coast, the tsunami and earthquake damage was strangely slight. That made it worse in another way. Reality had done something unreal, and people had no way to understand what they feared.

The police sent out on the emergency call were no exception. Calm the public? First they had to keep themselves in order, and even that was barely happening.

en.html:
Akitaka Kikuchi, chief of Kamakura Police, somehow gathered his unreliable men and reached the point where island met Katase. No clue to solving the emergency greeted him there.

Another calamity was announcing itself.
Heavy machinery, moving in a frantic rush. Cries with no sense in them.

He had known battlefields. He recognized it at once.
An army.

A small unit, for some unknown reason out of control and running completely wild. Starving wolves, ready to kill, wreck and ravage.

Small, yes. Still more than enough force to turn all of Katase into scorched earth. His lightly armed police would only be the appetizer.

ろう。

en.text: Chief"That thing..."

en.html:
The chief groaned the words.

That thing. The Silver Star.

What had happened on Enoshima, where he had sent Kageaki, he did not know. But apparently they had found their prize after all.

The Silver Star had appeared. Presumably it had driven the troops on the island mad.

Almost certainly a GHQ trap: that had been his judgment of this affair. But he had never ruled out the Silver Star appearing as well.

He had allowed for that.
Only, whatever happened would stay on the island. That was what he had counted on.
The civilians would be safe.

Very clever. Very naive.

Enoshima moving beside Katase Beach—who could predict such a thing? But some madness capable of overturning the whole situation: that possibility he should have considered.

He had heard Kageaki's reports again and again. After Kageaki himself, who knew better how far beyond the ordinary the Silver Star was?
His fist shook with regret. Too late for that also.

He saw them.
A stir behind him. His men must have seen them too.

A black whirl of men and vehicles, flesh and iron. Each howling and running in his own disorder, all advancing as one mass.

Like a juggernaut, that divine chariot which crushed people on their way to paradise. Delighting in slaughter, it came toward Katase.

The chief ordered his men into a defensive formation. He knew how much good it could do.

Stop them? However they struggled, no.
Perhaps bring a thousand dead down to nine hundred. That might be the limit.

A little water on a hot stone.
And who had failed to bring the liquid nitrogen? He himself.

He held his wavering men in place, swallowed his shame, and prepared to face it. A thousand people dying through his own incompetence.

ja.html:
その代名詞を、署長は呻いた。
　
　――<ruby>銀星号<rt>あいつ</rt></ruby>。

　景明を送り込んだ江ノ島で、何がどう推移したのか
はわからない。
　だがどうやら最後には<ruby>当たり<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>を引いたようだ。

　銀星号は顕現し……
　そして、島にいた軍部隊を狂わせたのだろう。

　――今回の件は十中八九、ＧＨＱの罠。
　署長はそう見ていたが、といって銀星号が現れる事
は絶対に無いなどと思い込んではいなかった。

　かくあるも考慮の内ではあった。
　が、何が起ころうと島の中の事で済む――と、そう
踏んでいたのだ。

　市民に害が及ぶことはなかろうと。
　……甘かった。

　江ノ島と片瀬海岸が隣接するなど、予測できた筈も
ないが――
　そのような狂変が情勢を根底から覆す可能性も有り
得るとは、考えておいて然るべきであった。

　幾度も景明の報告を聞き、銀星号の尋常ならざるを
彼に次ぐほどに知る身であったのだから！
　拳が悔恨に震える。しかしもう遅い。

　署長は見た。
　背後でざわめき。彼の部下らも見たのだろう。

　黒々とした、人と車と肉と鉄の渦。
　不揃いに吠え、ばらばらに駆け、だが一塊となって
突き進む。

　あたかも<ruby>祝福の戦車<rt>ジャガノート</rt></ruby>。
　人々を踏み殺して極楽へ送る神の輿のように、殺戮
を喜び踊りながら、それは片瀬へ向かって来る。

　署長は部下に迎撃隊形を指示した。
　その効果の程を理解しながら。

　どう足掻こうと、防ぎ止めることはできない。
　おそらく、千の死者を九百に減らすくらいが限度。

　焼け石に水だ。
　しかし液体窒素の備えを怠ったのは彼だった。

　浮き足立つ部下を抑えつつ、鎌倉署長は恥を呑み、
覚悟を決めた。
　己の無能によって千の人間を殺す、その覚悟を。

en.html:
The voice fell from above. At once, the whole pack went silent.

No human reason left. Nothing but an intoxication with destruction. Still they obeyed a command they could not understand.

Why?

Awe.

As a man-eating tiger lowers its head before a saint.
As a unicorn sleeps in an innocent maiden's lap.

Divine might—kamui. Even a mindless beast bows before it.

　その形状かたち。

　署長には覚えがあった。
　八幡宮秘蔵の文書類の中に、見たことがある。

　古い絵巻物――
　そこに描かれていた姿。

en.html: Chief"That is—"
en.text: Chief"That is—"

ja.html: 署長「あれは」
ja.text: 署長「あれは」

en.html:
—First beneath heaven.
Not even China's Ganjiang and Moye, nor Suimou and Tai'a, can equal it.

It is no different from the keen armor of the Immovable One—
en.text:
—First beneath heaven.
Not even China's Ganjiang and Moye, nor Suimou and Tai'a, can equal it.

It is no different from the keen armor of the Immovable One—

ja.html:
――天下第一等。
　唐国の干将莫耶、吹毛太阿も之に及ばず。

　不動の利甲に異ならざる也――

One flash, like an exploding depth charge.

Enoshima and Katase were separate again.

　江ノ島と片瀬を、再び切り離した。
